claim: ElastiCache provides defense-in-depth security: encryption at rest with AWS KMS, encryption in transit with TLS, authentication with AWS IAM, and network access control with VPC security groups. You can enable Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for fine-grained permissions for different users in the same cache. For caches with a public endpoint, security groups do not apply and access is controlled through IAM policies.

qualifiers.condition: security groups do not apply to caches with a public endpoint

evidence.quote: ElastiCache provides defense-in-depth security with encryption at rest (AWS KMS), encryption in transit (TLS), authentication with AWS IAM, and network access control with VPC security groups. You can enable Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to grant fine-grained permissions to different users within the same cache. For caches with a public endpoint, security groups do not apply and access is controlled through IAM policies.
